  std::string capability
  std::vector<std::string> contracts
  std::vector<std::string> guarantees
  Scope scope
struct ServiceReference
  std::string provider
  std::string capability
  std::string contract
  std::vector<std::string> guarantees
  Scope scope
  std::string transport
  std::string endpoint

  ResolutionStatus status
  std::optional<ServiceReference> reference
struct BootstrapObservation
  BootstrapState state
  std::string detail
struct CapabilityObservation

  std::optional<ResolveResult> result

  BootstrapObservation bootstrap
  std::vector<CapabilityObservation> capabilities

  std::string attribute
  std::string proof
  std::string ceiling

  std::string stronger

  ServiceReadiness readiness
  std::string why
  std::vector<std::string> guarantees
  std::map<std::string, std::string> capabilities
struct Description
  DescriptionOutcome outcome
  std::string program
  std::string version
  std::vector<ServiceState> services
struct RemoteTrust
  std::string server_name
  std::string roots
  std::string certificate
  std::string key
  std::string credential
struct Declaration
  std::string name
  std::string program
  std::vector<std::string> arguments
  std::string endpoint
  DeclarationTransport transport
  std::vector<std::string> contracts
  std::vector<std::string> guarantees
  std::vector<std::string> resources
  Activation activation
  std::optional<RemoteTrust> remote
  std::vector<std::string> models
struct DeclarationState
  Declaration declaration
  std::string declared_by
  std::int64_t declared_unix_ms
  DeclarationReadiness readiness
  std::string why
  std::int64_t restarts
  std::vector<ServiceState> described
  std::vector<std::string> accepted

  std::string revision
  std::string reason
struct DeclarationObservation
  DeclarationListOutcome outcome
  std::string cursor
  std::vector<DeclarationState> declarations

  std::string name
  std::string protocol
  std::string contract

  std::string title
  std::string revision

struct Registry
  virtual DeclarationList declarations()
  virtual DeclarationChange declare(const std::string& expected_revision, const Declaration& declaration)
  virtual DeclarationChange withdraw(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name)
  virtual DeclarationObservation observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
template<class Transport>struct RegistryClient : Registry
  Transport& transport_
  DeclarationList declarations() override
  DeclarationChange declare(const std::string& expected_revision, const Declaration& declaration) override
  DeclarationChange withdraw(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name) override
  DeclarationObservation observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
struct RegistryService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct RegistryDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  Registry& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct Applications
  virtual ApplicationChange register_(const ApplicationDescriptor& descriptor)
  virtual ApplicationChange remove(const std::string& application)
  virtual ApplicationChange announce(const ApplicationPresence& presence)
  virtual ApplicationChange withdraw(const std::string& application, const std::string& instance)
  virtual ApplicationPage observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual ApplicationActivationResult activate(const std::string& application)
template<class Transport>struct ApplicationsClient : Applications
  Transport& transport_
  ApplicationChange register_(const ApplicationDescriptor& descriptor) override
  ApplicationChange remove(const std::string& application) override
  ApplicationChange announce(const ApplicationPresence& presence) override
  ApplicationChange withdraw(const std::string& application, const std::string& instance) override
  ApplicationPage observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
  ApplicationActivationResult activate(const std::string& application) override
struct ApplicationsService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct ApplicationsDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  Applications& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
